description: Per-channel visual sourcing rules. Each channel independently sources assets and selects visual treatments appropriate to its content. A video must not inherit another video's photographs or graphic sequence merely because they exist in a cache.

ch-01.name: Hidden Past
ch-01.niche: History, forgotten events, historical figures, mysteries and significant moments from the past.
ch-01.visualIdentity: newspaper-collage, archival, sepia, dramatic Ken Burns photo pushes, document animations, map territory pans
forbiddenFallbacks: Generic stock photographs of unrelated historical events
Modern photographs presented as period evidence

ch-02.name: AI Tested
ch-02.niche: Artificial intelligence tools, models, experiments, demonstrations, comparisons and practical applications.
ch-02.visualIdentity: dark mode, purple accent, clean tech aesthetic, screen captures, split-screen comparisons, output zooms, workflow diagrams
forbiddenFallbacks: Generic robot / brain stock imagery presented as a specific AI tool
Product screenshots from a different tool

ch-03.name: Court & Spotlight
ch-03.niche: Legal cases, trials, court proceedings, legal controversies and high-profile people involved in them.
ch-03.visualIdentity: court buildings, legal timelines, document presentations, evidence boards, public figures, official records
preferredSources: Reputable news sources with licensed imagery
forbiddenFallbacks: Unrelated courtroom photograph presented as case-specific
Stock gavel / scales of justice as case evidence
Unrelated person presented as a party to the case

ch-04.name: Rival Lines
ch-04.niche: Sports rivalries, head-to-head comparisons, competitors, career battles and defining moments.
ch-04.visualIdentity: sports photography, scoreboards, head-to-head stats, tactical diagrams, career timelines, venue photographs
forbiddenFallbacks: Generic sports photographs reused for every rivalry
Unrelated athletes presented as the competitors discussed
Stock stadium imagery presented as a specific venue

brand.description: Logos, colours, typography, channel identity — safe to reuse across all videos on a channel.

channel.description: Channel-specific reusable assets that are not topic-bound (e.g. a channel's signature map style).

video.description: Assets sourced for a specific video's topic. Reuse only when the same subject is genuinely relevant and documented.
video.example: photo of Margaret Clitherow for the Clitherow video only

temp.description: Temporary production files (candidates, thumbnails, work-in-progress). Never reused.

reusePolicy.default: No automatic reuse. A photograph of a person, event, product or location must not be reused simply because it exists in the cache.
reusePolicy.justifiedReuse: For repeated topics or follow-up episodes, reuse is appropriate where the same subject is genuinely relevant. The decision and reason must be recorded in the visual plan.
reusePolicy.brandException: Brand elements, logos and channel identity may be reused freely within a channel.
